title: Book Two · Chapter 77: The Slow Hour
story:
One wet Saturday in late summer, Dad brings a small account book to the kitchen table. He needs an old customer's address for Mr Sun. Ronan is drawing beside the window.

Dad opens the old book. A loose page lies near the back. Ronan sees numbers and several crossed lines.

“Is that from your shop?”

“Yes.”

“Did you earn that much?”

Ronan points to one large number. Dad shakes his head.

“That is money in. This side is money out.”

He turns the book so Ronan can see the two columns. The first has payments. The second has wood, parts and rent. A smaller number stands at the bottom.

“Where are your hours?” Ronan asks.

Dad looks at the page for a moment. Rain taps against the window.

“Not all there. I counted some parts. I did not count enough of my time.”

Ronan points to a little mark beside a payment.

“That customer paid twice?”

“No. I returned part of the payment.”

“Why?”

“The work was late. Then I had to mend it again.”

Dad shows him another line. It is for a door, not the brown jewellery box. The door needed a second visit. Dad bought another part. He went back and worked for another afternoon.

“Did the customer pay for that afternoon?”

“No. I needed to put my work right.”

Ronan tries to add the numbers in his head. He can add the price of the part. But Dad worked all afternoon too. The book does not show a cost for that time.

“Why did you say yes to more jobs?”

“I wanted more money in. I thought I could finish faster.”

Dad closes one hand over the edge of the book. He does not smile. Ronan looks at the green door, then back at him.

“Are you doing that now?”

“I check the work and the time with Mr Sun. Sometimes I still want to promise too soon.”

Mum brings her cup to the table. Dad starts to put the book away. Mum asks him for the address. He finds the address. He writes it on clean paper for work. The account book stays private at home.

Later, Dad puts it back on the shelf. Ronan does not ask to draw it for school. He returns to his own page.

His picture has a table with four short legs. He adds Dad beside it. Dad leans over his shoulder.

“Those legs are all the same.”

“Yes,” Ronan says. “I checked.”

Dad sits down beside him. Together, they draw a chair with very long legs. There is no good place for a person's feet.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

hour＝小时；account book＝账本；payment＝付款。

## 理解问题

1. Dad账上哪些时间从前没有算进去？
2. Ronan看见了怎样的实际后果？

## 读句子

**Dad / opens / the old book.** Dad／翻开／那本旧账本。
